scripts.dev: pnpm shared:build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @cyberian/api dev" "pnpm --filter @cyberian/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm shared:build && pnpm --filter @cyberian/api build && pnpm --filter @cyberian/web build
scripts.test: pnpm shared:build && pnpm --filter @cyberian/api test && pnpm --filter @cyberian/web test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm shared:build && pnpm --filter @cyberian/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @cyberian/web typecheck
